Alright guys! Welcome to the subtank recommendation megathread! Subtanks are Aspire Atlantes (Atlantises?), Herakleseses, Kanger Subtanks, etc.

The Rules

All parent comments must be in the following format:

 Manufacturer |Tank Name |Price Range |Review Link
---------|----------

* Discussions on why you personally recommend it

So it ends up looking like:

For instance:

KangerTech Subtank Mini $29.95 Review

Moderator's note: If a published written or video review is not trustworthy (e.g. super shilly, contains no real information, etc.), then a link to something like an ECF thread is acceptable. All the better if it has pictures. Trustworthiness of reviews will be decided by the mods.

  • I would recommend the Subtank Mini because it is 22mm in diameter, so it'll be flush with most mods. It comes with an RBA base (which will be discussed over in the Authentic RTA Megathread), which is very useful. The throat hit and flavor are great, and the only con I can come up with in my months of using one, is that sometimes the glass tank section leaks a little or "sweats".

Any questions, additional reviews or information regarding the tanks should take place in response to the parent comment.

All discussions of sales, additional reviews, pricing, etc. will be posted in response to the original piece of gear. Double posts will be deleted.

Feel free to link to reviews that have been posted on /v/vaping already as part of the post.

Rules will be updated as needed.

But /u/NewFatMike, why is this thing?

Until we have a wiki capacity, this will be a useful tool to come to for new gear reviews. Furthermore, it will be good to have a running record of what gear is out there. This thread will be useful because it will let us see more novel and new gear for the people who want to see it and provide a wealth of information for people coming in late to learn everything they want in discussion about the piece of gear in question.

Go forth, vaping lovelies, and recommend!
The Subtank Recommendation Megathread: Yes, my Herakhaleesi, these are phat cloudz.

KangerTech Subtank Mini $30 - $35 Video Review

Notes: It's my daily workhorse. Reliable, dummy-proofed, and affordable. Individual coil heads come in either .5 or 1.2ohm versions with their own wattage ratings (preferences) printed on the side. Manufactured coil heads put out copious amounts of flavorful, thick vapor - consistently. To add; the kit comes with an RBA that allows you to build your own coils and use your own wicking material. Essentially allowing you to use the subtank for as long as you've got kanthal and cotton. There's a million and one things written, spoken and praised about it in just about every corner of the internet that deals with vaping. It's about as close to the 'standard' as you can get - from a company that has a decent reputation already established in the community. Newer versions of the Subtank Mini (that ship with the Subox Mini Kit, but are also available by themselves) use an updated standard atomizer casing for better juice feeding when using higher VG juices. The RBA attachment has also been updated, with better feed channels and an easier-to-remove outer tank shield - making swapping out gross wicks for fresh ones even easier.

Horizon Arctic $25 - $30 Video Review

Notes: It's amazing! Great flavor and great vapor. Good tank size and is my all day setup.

Here's my gripe though. There's only two juice holes on the coil head, so In between those, on the inside, the cotton burns quickly. I also use max vg juices and lots of custards so my coils only last a few days at most. That's to be expected with gunky juices like custards though.

On a side note: Looking to try out some RTA's though. Have a billow v2 that will be here from Hawaii on Tuesday I'm stoked about.
